game.name: Dante's Inferno (Europe)(En,De,It)
game.desc: A soul taken away. A life of sin. An adventure into the depths of despair. Inspired by the literary classic, Dante's Inferno takes you through the nine circles of Hell on a quest for vengeance and redemption. You are Dante, a veteran of the Crusades, who must save his beloved Beatrice and free her from the clutches of Lucifer. Dive into the depths of Hell, where you must not only face terrifying monsters, but also your own sins, a dark past and your own unforgivable war crimes. Go to Hell.
